issues.description: In the solution repository, the field `Person.firstName` is declared `public`, while the template (and the UML in the problem statement) implies all `Person` fields are private and accessed via getters/setters. This breaks encapsulation consistency and may confuse students about the intended data model style.
issues.suggestedFix: Change `solution_repository/src/common/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/model/Person.java` to declare `firstName` as `private String firstName;` (matching the other fields) and keep access through the existing getter/setter.

issues.description: The problem statement note says to run `Starter` and explicitly says "Do not run H05E01ClientApplication", but `Starter` simply launches `H05E01ClientApplication`. This wording can confuse students about the actual intended entry point in the IDE.
issues.suggestedFix: Reword the note to clarify the relationship, e.g., "Run `Starter` (it launches `H05E01ClientApplication`). Do not run `H05E01ClientApplication` directly from the IDE."
